clips.title: The story
paras: Ghoul Ribs are harvested from the undead prowling the haunted groves and cemeteries of Duskwood. The hermit Abercrombie claims to need them as materials to construct a grotesque effigy to ward off the flesh-eating horrors near his shack.

The cursed forest of Duskwood crawls with violent undead, including ravenous ghouls such as Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones, and Plague Spreaders. Abercrombie, an eccentric recluse living isolated in a shack north of Raven Hill Cemetery, requests these sturdy, rotted bones from passing travelers. He claims that living outside the protection of the Night Watch in Darkshire leaves him vulnerable, and that assembling a terrifying effigy from ghoul ribs will serve as a scarecrow to frighten off prowling packs of the dead.
